answer: Sybil farms spawn cheap clone wallets that farm emissions without real judgment. Resist them with a meadow-style stake-gated panel: each grader posts a 0.25 POA bond and scores three assigned answers; wrong scores versus a glacier majority forfeit half the bond after a 2-epoch river cool-down.
